message.content: Keysight Technologies Inc sells technology solutions to engineering teams across end markets including AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor, and general electronics [D1]. The company serves as a mission-critical design enablement partner for the world's most complex engineering challenges by connecting market-leading design, emulation, and test solutions across the full lifecycle [D1]. Customers rely on Keysight to bridge virtual design and physical reality, enabling confident decisions earlier in the development process [D1].
